_comment: FROZEN Phase-1 v4 (team default as of 2026-10-06 05:30 PT): 200 ft step, 600 fpm ramp with 0.1 g corners, climb-rate feed-forward, heading hold, track + 2*effort + 0.05*comfort + 0.01*heading_rms, 3 legacy scenarios, mean. Task-level knobs are pinned here so later shared-set defaults can't change v4; aircraft data (trim, envelope, gain bounds, bank limit) comes from phase1_shared.json, and tests/test_v5.py pins the resulting costs bit for bit. Use --aircraft c172x | t38 | b737.
